*Jollof Rice* 🌴 West African classic

📋 *Ingredients:*
• 2 cups long-grain parboiled rice
• 400g blended tomatoes + 2 tbsp tomato paste
• 1 onion, 1 red bell pepper, scotch bonnet
• 60ml vegetable oil, 2 cups chicken stock
• Thyme, curry powder, bay leaf, salt

👨‍🍳 *Steps:*
1. Fry onions in oil, add tomato paste and blended tomato-pepper mix; cook down 10 min.
2. Season with thyme, curry, bay leaf; add stock.
3. Stir in washed rice, cover with foil + lid, steam on low 25–30 min.
4. Fluff and let the base toast slightly for smoky party flavour.

⏱ 45 min | 🔥 ~380 kcal | 💪 Easy

*Egusi Soup* 🌴 West African favourite

📋 *Ingredients:*
• 2 cups ground egusi (melon seeds)
• 300g spinach or bitterleaf
• Assorted meat/fish, 60ml palm oil
• 1 onion, ground crayfish, pepper, stock cubes

👨‍🍳 *Steps:*
1. Cook meat with onions and seasoning; keep the stock.
2. Heat palm oil, fry ground egusi paste in lumps 10 min.
3. Add stock gradually, simmer 15 min.
4. Add crayfish, pepper, greens; simmer 5 more min.
5. Serve with pounded yam, fufu or rice.

⏱ 50 min | 🔥 ~510 kcal | 💪 Medium

*Suya Skewers* 🌴 West African street food

📋 *Ingredients:*
• 500g beef sirloin, thinly sliced
• Suya spice (yaji): ground kuli-kuli/peanut, ginger, garlic, cayenne, paprika, salt
• Oil for brushing, onions + tomatoes to serve

👨‍🍳 *Steps:*
1. Thread beef on skewers, brush lightly with oil.
2. Coat generously in yaji spice, rest 15 min.
3. Grill on high heat 5–7 min per side.
4. Dust with extra yaji; serve with sliced onions and tomatoes.

⏱ 30 min | 🔥 ~340 kcal | 💪 Easy

*Injera with Tibs* ☕ East African (Ethiopia)

📋 *Ingredients:*
• Injera flatbread (teff sourdough)
• 500g beef or lamb, cubed
• 2 onions, 2 tomatoes, jalapeño
• Niter kibbeh (spiced butter), berbere spice, rosemary

👨‍🍳 *Steps:*
1. Sear meat cubes in hot niter kibbeh.
2. Add onions, tomatoes, jalapeño and rosemary; sauté.
3. Season with berbere; cook until juices thicken.
4. Serve sizzling over injera — eat with your hands!

⏱ 60 min | 🔥 ~450 kcal | 💪 Medium

*Ugali with Sukuma Wiki* ☕ East African (Kenya)

📋 *Ingredients:*
• 2 cups maize flour + 4 cups water
• 1 bunch sukuma wiki (collard greens), sliced
• 1 onion, 2 tomatoes, oil, salt

👨‍🍳 *Steps:*
1. Boil water, whisk in maize flour gradually.
2. Stir vigorously until stiff; steam 3–4 min and mould.
3. Fry onions, add tomatoes, then greens; cook 5 min.
4. Serve ugali hot with the sukuma wiki alongside.

⏱ 20 min | 🔥 ~290 kcal | 💪 Easy

*Chicken Tagine* 🏜 North African (Morocco)

📋 *Ingredients:*
• 1 whole chicken, cut up
• 2 onions, 3 garlic cloves, preserved lemon
• Green olives, ginger, turmeric, saffron, cinnamon
• Olive oil, fresh coriander + parsley

👨‍🍳 *Steps:*
1. Marinate chicken in spices, garlic and herbs 30 min.
2. Brown in olive oil in the tagine or heavy pot.
3. Add onions and a little water; cover, simmer low 1 hour.
4. Add olives and preserved lemon for the last 10 min.

⏱ 90 min | 🔥 ~420 kcal | 💪 Medium

*Shakshuka* 🏜 North African brunch star

📋 *Ingredients:*
• 4–6 eggs
• 400g crushed tomatoes, 1 red bell pepper
• 1 onion, 3 garlic cloves
• Cumin, paprika, harissa or chilli, olive oil, feta (optional)

👨‍🍳 *Steps:*
1. Sauté onion and pepper in olive oil; add garlic and spices.
2. Pour in tomatoes; simmer 10 min until thick.
3. Make wells, crack in eggs; cover and cook 5–8 min.
4. Finish with herbs (and feta); serve with crusty bread.

⏱ 25 min | 🔥 ~310 kcal | 💪 Easy

*Fufu with Ndolé* 🌳 Central African (Cameroon 🇨🇲)

📋 *Ingredients:*
• Ndolé (bitterleaf), washed several times
• 250g groundnuts (peanuts), boiled and blended
• Beef, smoked fish and/or shrimp
• 2 onions, garlic, crayfish, palm oil
• Fufu: cassava or plantain, pounded

👨‍🍳 *Steps:*
1. Cook meat/fish with onions and garlic; keep stock.
2. Simmer blended groundnuts in the stock 15 min.
3. Add washed ndolé leaves, crayfish and shrimp; cook 15 min.
4. Fry garnish onions in oil, fold in; serve with hot fufu.

⏱ 55 min | 🔥 ~490 kcal | 💪 Medium

🥗 *Healthy Meal Plans*

7-day plans built around authentic African dishes. Pick one to see the daily breakdown:

🥗 *7-Day Balanced Plan* (~1900 kcal/day)

*Day 1:* Akara + pap | Jollof rice + grilled fish | Egusi soup + fufu
*Day 2:* Oats + mango | Yassa chicken + rice | Ugali + sukuma wiki
*Day 3:* Boiled plantain + eggs | Thieboudienne | Light okra soup
*Day 4:* Millet porridge | Suya wrap + salad | Chicken tagine + couscous
*Day 5:* Avocado toast + baobab juice | Waakye | Grilled tilapia + attiéké
*Day 6:* Shakshuka | Groundnut stew + rice | Vegetable ndolé
*Day 7:* Puff-puff + fruit | Injera + tibs | Pepper soup

💡 Drink water before each meal; palm oil in moderation.

💪 *High-Protein Plan* (~2100 kcal/day)

*Day 1:* Eggs + beans | Grilled chicken + jollof | Fish pepper soup
*Day 2:* Greek yoghurt + groundnuts | Suya skewers + salad | Egusi + lean beef
*Day 3:* Akara (bean cakes) | Tilapia + attiéké | Chicken tagine
*Day 4:* Omelette + avocado | Beef tibs + injera | Lentil stew
*Day 5:* Sardines + toast | Yassa chicken | Grilled prawns + rice
*Day 6:* Eggs + kontomire | Goat pepper soup | Ndolé with shrimp
*Day 7:* Bean porridge | Grilled guinea fowl | Fish stew + ugali

💡 Aim for a palm-size portion of protein at every meal.

🌱 *Vegan African Plan* (~1800 kcal/day)

*Day 1:* Akara + pap | Jollof + plantain | Lentil soup + injera
*Day 2:* Fonio porridge | Moroccan chickpea tagine | Vegetable ndolé
*Day 3:* Mango + groundnut butter | Veggie shakshuka (no eggs) | Ugali + sukuma wiki
*Day 4:* Millet + dates | Red-red (beans + plantain) | Okra soup + fufu
*Day 5:* Baobab smoothie | Couscous + roast vegetables | Groundnut stew
*Day 6:* Kelewele + fruit | Waakye (no fish) | Spinach + sweet potato
*Day 7:* Oats + hibiscus tea | Yam porridge | Veggie suya (mushroom)

💡 Groundnuts, beans and fonio keep protein high without meat.

🌙 *Tonight's Dinner Ideas*

Three quick fixes — all ready in 30 minutes or less. Tap one for the full recipe:

🛒 *African Pantry Essentials*

• *Grains & starch:* rice, maize flour, gari, fonio, couscous
• *Legumes:* black-eyed beans, lentils, groundnuts
• *Oils:* palm oil (use sparingly), groundnut oil, olive oil
• *Spices:* suya/yaji spice, berbere, ras el hanout, grains of selim, crayfish powder
• *Fresh:* plantain, cassava, yam, okra, bitterleaf, scotch bonnet
• *Extras:* dried fish, egusi seeds, hibiscus (for zobo), baobab powder

💡 *Tip:* Buy spices whole and grind small batches — flavour lasts much longer.
